verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents that users can manually add, edit, or delete stored memories (Settings > Personalization > Memory). Its self-hosted, offline-capable design keeps data on the operator's own infrastructure. Beyond memory deletion, the pack shows no retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: chat/conversation deletion controls, configurable retention policies or auto-expiry, file/RAG document deletion, admin-level data purge or export, independent corroboration.
